item.title: Iran Qatar Strikes: What the Gulf Escalation Means
item.description:
Qatar spent the last two decades as the one Gulf Arab state that stayed friendly with Iran. On the morning of 12 July 2026, that relationship was shattered by ballistic missiles falling over Doha.

The Iran Qatar strikes mark one of the sharpest escalations of the 2026 Iran war. Iran unleashed simultaneous waves of missiles and drones across Qatar, the UAE, Bahrain, and Kuwait — hours after a fresh round of US airstrikes inside Iran.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Blockade: The Essential Guide to Trump's Naval Gamble
item.description:
Strait of Hormuz Blockade: The Essential Guide to Trump’s Naval Gamble

About 20% of the world’s oil and gas used to move through a stretch of water barely 21 miles wide at its narrowest point. As of this week, the US Navy is deciding who gets to cross it.

The strait of hormuz us blockade began at roughly 10 a.m. ET on April 13, 2026, after peace talks in Pakistan between Washington and Tehran collapsed the day before. President Donald Trump ordered US Central Command to intercept vessels traveling to or from Iranian ports, turning a seven-week war into a global economic standoff.

item.title: Lindsey Graham Under Fire: Iran War Rhetoric Sparks GOP Civil War and Reelection Crisis
item.description:
Has a single weekend ever done more damage to a sitting senator’s standing within his own party? Lindsey Graham’s call for the United States to seize Iran’s Kharg Island has ignited a firestorm — not from Democrats, but from fellow Republicans who say the South Carolina senator is treating American troops like “expendable cattle.”

Key Takeaways

  • Graham urged President Trump to “take Kharg Island” and let Iran’s regime “die on a vine,” comparing the operation to Iwo Jima.
  • Multiple MAGA-aligned Republicans — including Marjorie Taylor Greene and Nancy Mace — publicly denounced his rhetoric.
  • Graham’s approval rating in South Carolina sits at just 34 percent, making his 2026 reelection bid one of the most vulnerable in the Senate.
  • Trump has endorsed Graham and dispatched former campaign manager Chris LaCivita to advise his campaign.

Lindsey Graham’s Kharg Island Push Draws Bipartisan Outrage

Over the weekend, Senator Graham appeared on Fox News and made a bold pitch: he urged President Donald Trump to order a military strike on Kharg Island, a critical hub for Iran’s oil exports.
